headline: Jake Tapper: Trump’s Outside Advisers Pushing For Martial Law Takeover Of Midterms
trending_claim: Outside advisers to Trump, including attorney Peter Tickton, are urging him to take federal control of the 2026 midterms — including by declaring martial law on or around Election Day — as reported by The Atlantic and covered in a CNN segment by Jake Tapper.
trending_context: Front-page lead on Crooks and Liars' 'The Latest' on Sep 26–27, driven by The Atlantic's reporting and Jake Tapper's CNN segment.

headline: SCOTUS Again Blocks Missouri’s Gerrymandered Congressional Map
trending_claim: In a unanimous unsigned decision, the Supreme Court ordered Missouri to use the 2022 congressional map — not the legislature's 2025 gerrymandered map — for the 2026 election, ruling that as a matter of state law the 2022 map must be used.
trending_context: Leading Crooks and Liars on Sep 26 (via the Missouri Independent), capping three weeks of court fights that changed the map in place five times.

headline: US Amb. To China Insists Trump Got Assurances From Xi On Iran
trending_claim: U.S. Ambassador to China David Perdue claimed on Fox News that Xi Jinping assured Trump that China would stop direct or indirect support for Iran, and that the two leaders agreed Iran would never get a nuclear weapon and the Strait of Hormuz would stay open — even as CBS reported the Xi visit ended with few achievements announced.
trending_context: Trending on Crooks and Liars on Sep 26 amid coverage of Xi's White House state dinner; Aaron Rupar's clip of the Fox segment circulated widely on the left.

headline: White House bars CNN from covering Trump on behalf of major TV networks as he travels to Tennessee
trending_claim: The White House barred CNN from flying on Air Force One to Tennessee for its scheduled TV pool duties — leaving no television pool coverage of the trip — days after a federal judge ordered the administration to restore CNN, MS NOW and Politico's White House credentials.
trending_context: Top story on Memeorandum Sep 26–27 with related items from the NYT, Politico, NBC and the Guardian; the press-pool fight dominated left-leaning media all weekend.

headline: Talarico Challenges Chickensh*t Paxton To Fox News Debate
trending_claim: Democrat James Talarico challenged Republican Ken Paxton to debate on Fox News with Bret Baier moderating, after Paxton refused debate invitations from CNN and the Texas Tribune Festival and went silent on an earlier commitment to debate.
trending_context: High on Crooks and Liars' latest list on Sep 26–27 as the Texas Senate race heats up.

headline: Sen Tuberville Admits ‘I Read Very Little’ Because No Other Opinion Matters
trending_claim: Sen. Tommy Tuberville told Raw Story's Matt Laslo 'I read very little... I want my own opinion, not somebody else's,' and showed no knowledge of the White House press ban or a ProPublica report that a Kremlin-linked oligarch financed Donald Trump Jr.'s wedding party.
trending_context: Widely shared on the left on Sep 26 (Raw Story original) as an emblem of GOP incuriosity; featured on Crooks and Liars.

headline: Sen. John Cornyn Refuses To Raise A Dime For Ken Paxton
trending_claim: Outgoing Sen. John Cornyn told CNN's Manu Raju he will not fundraise at all for GOP Senate nominee Ken Paxton, who beat him in the primary, calling Paxton a flawed candidate and warning that nominating unappealing candidates is 'how majority parties become minority parties.'
trending_context: Trending on Crooks and Liars on Sep 26; Aaron Rupar's clip of the Raju interview circulated on Bluesky, highlighting GOP divisions in the Texas Senate race.

headline: Another MAGA Rat Flees Trump’s Sinking Oil Tanker
trending_claim: Wisconsin GOP gubernatorial candidate Rep. Tom Tiffany — who voted five times to keep the Iran war going after earlier calling for an exit — is now calling for the U.S. to leave Iran as diesel hits all-time highs, saying 'it's time to move on... Time to come home, take care of business here in America.'
trending_context: Featured on Crooks and Liars on Sep 26, tying soaring diesel prices to GOP figures breaking with Trump over the Iran war.

headline: Palm Beach County, Home To Mar-a-Lago, Passes Data Center Moratorium
trending_claim: Palm Beach County commissioners voted 6-0 to enact a one-year moratorium on new large-scale (50+ megawatt) data centers, despite Trump saying every town should want one and that communities opposing them will end up 'backwards' and 'poor.'
trending_context: Amplified by Sen. Bernie Sanders on Sep 25 and trending in left media Sep 26 as a rebuke of Trump's data-center push in his own backyard (via Common Dreams).

headline: Roger Marshall’s Past Just Got Turned Into A BRUTAL Campaign Ad
trending_claim: A new campaign ad spotlights Sen. Roger Marshall's history of aggressive medical-debt collection: his practice sued more than 700 patients over unpaid bills, at least 81 were arrested after missing court, including a woman arrested in 2011 over a missed $50 payment while eight months pregnant.
trending_context: Trending on Crooks and Liars on Sep 26, fueling scrutiny of Marshall's medical-debt record ahead of his reelection bid.

headline: Iran says it is awaiting ‘definitive’ US response despite Trump rejecting latest proposal
trending_claim: Trump publicly rejected Iran's proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz within a week and resume nuclear talks (in exchange for lifting the naval blockade and oil sanctions), calling it 'unacceptable,' though Iran says no formal rejection has come through mediators; the WSJ reported Trump told staff a renewed bombing campaign is likely after the midterms.
trending_context: The weekend's top story on Memeorandum (AP, Axios, NYT, Politico all leading it Sep 26–27); CNN's version was updated Sunday with UN Ambassador Mike Waltz's 'State of the Union' comments.

headline: White House Claim of $250 Billion in Fraud Questionable
trending_claim: The New York Times' Linda Qiu found the White House fraud task force's ledger — touted by JD Vance as $250 billion in fraud found since he became 'fraud czar' — is difficult to verify, includes cases from the Biden administration, and leans on unverified or prematurely counted allegations.
trending_context: Trending on Memeorandum Sep 27 via the NYT fact-check (summarized by Political Wire), challenging the administration's fraud-ledger claims.

headline: Trump allies could use midterms ‘counting window’ to disrupt results, experts warn
trending_claim: Election experts including former officials Caitlin Durkovich, Larry Norden and Ben Hovland warn the Trump administration could exploit the post-election 'counting window' — using claims of foreign interference to seize equipment or ballots and amplify unfounded fraud allegations to challenge midterm results.
trending_context: On Memeorandum's front page Sep 27 (George Chidi, Guardian); widely shared in left circles amid election-subversion fears. Note: theguardian.com is unreachable from this environment, so the article was verified via a verbatim mirror.
